listings.title: Pet Rabbit with Cage Setup
listings.description: Live pet rabbit in wire cage with bedding and feeding setup. The rabbit appears healthy and well-cared for with soft white and grey fur. This would be suitable for families looking to adopt a pet rabbit with basic housing included.
